title: Canadian Citizenship
description: Everything in the official IRCC study guide, Discover Canada, turned into a complete course — history, government, rights and responsibilities, symbols, and every region. Built from the actual government guide (including its own real photos), not a summary of it — reading through this course covers the same ground as reading the book itself.

changelog.notes: Removed a whole pack (preview + main + 4 practice cards, 6 cards total) duplicated verbatim in two decks — the NWMP-founding pack existed identically in both "The Road to Confederation" and "Building the Dominion"; kept the copy in "Building the Dominion" (NWMP founded in 1873, after Confederation). Reworded 5 other cards that duplicated a sibling deck's card text verbatim while covering a genuinely different angle of the same fact, so each pack now tests something distinct instead of repeating a sibling word-for-word.

Initial release — built from the official Discover Canada study guide (IRCC), using the guide's own photos as card images, covering all 18 decks: applying for citizenship, rights and responsibilities, history, government, justice, symbols, the economy, and every region.
